violations.text: The handwashing sink in the grab and go warewashing area was missing soap and paper towels. The handwashing sink near the grab and go cookline was missing soap. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026

Food contact surfaces of the ice machine was observed with an accumulation of black residue. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice was voluntarily disposed of. Ice machine must be thoroughly cleaned and sanitized prior to use. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026

Mashed potatoes were observed held at 123 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Mashed potatoes were reheated to 189 degrees Fahrenheit during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026

Tuna salad observed held at 55 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Top rail prep unit lid was observed missing and was replaced. Tuna salad was placed into other refrigeration during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026
Cheese sauce was observed held past 7 days. Food was voluntarily disposed of during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026

ROP halibut was observed at 41-42 degrees Fahrenheit with the packaging still intact. ROP halibut was assessed and voluntarily disposed of during time of inspection. To thaw properly you must: remove the frozen seafood products from the packaging and thaw under refrigeration (41°F or below); or thaw by submerging under cold running water. If thawing by submerging under cold running water, you can keep the product in its packaging during thawing, but you must remove it immediately once thawed. The product temperature during thawing should not exceed 41°F. https://health.ri.gov/sites/g/files/xkgbur1006/files/2025-08/SafeHandling_ROP_Seafood.pdf Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026
Various foods in the walk-in freezer were observed stored on the floor. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets for cookline prep unit were observed in poor repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/05/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the Sink and Surface sanitizing solution for the Grab n Go 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 11/19/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the sides of the fryers, interior and exterior of refrigeration unit and mounting pieces of the food slicer have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. The non-food contact surfaces of the slicer were cleaned and sanitized during time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 11/19/2026

The floors in the walk-in cooler, the floors and walls near kitchen back door and the floors and walls in the grab and go areas the have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 11/19/2026
The wall area behind server station soup station and baskets is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/05/2026

Raw animal foods such as raw chicken were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods such as leaf lettuce and pasta in the bottom lowboy of prep unit. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/30/2025

Various foods were observed held at 44-51 degrees Fahrenheit (stored on lip of top rail prep unit). Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Time/temperature abused foodS were voluntarily disposed of during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/30/2025

Grab and go items packaged in the food establishment are lacking all required information on food label. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients (including sub ingredients), the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 11/13/2025

The floors under equipment and cookline and surrounding walls in main kitchen have an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 11/13/2025

Raw animal foods eggs were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods cheese, garlic in oil, and prepared salads in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Separation storage poster provided during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/10/2024

Floor tiles by 3 bay sink in main kitchen were observed in poor repair. Physical facilities must be in good repair and proper adjustment. PIC provided proof of quoted repairs to be completed during time of inspection. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 12/27/2024

Raw animal foods were not stored properly to prevent cross-contamination in the walk-in cooler and grill drawers in kitchen. Except when combined as ingredients, different types of raw animal foods must be separated from each other during storage by using separate equipment or arrranging each type of food in equipment so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/27/2024

Food contact surfaces of icemachine was observed with an accumulation of black and pink residue. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machine was turned off and taken out of service during time of inspection. Ice machine to be thoroughly cleaned and sanitized prior to use. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/27/2024

Minestrone soup and cooked sausage, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. Food was voluntarily disposed of during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/27/2024

Various foods in cookline prep unit and server station refrigerator were observed held between 53-58 degrees Fahrenheit. Foods in cookline prep unit were observed stored above the cold hold well on the lip of the unit. Ambient temperature of server station refrigerator observed at 47 degrees Fahreneheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods that were out of temperature for an unknown amount of time were voluntarily disposed of. Server refrigerator taken out of service during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/27/2024
Drinking ware and condiments were observed in close proximity to handsink. Items to be relocated. New Violation. Correct By: 09/27/2024
Floor tiles by 3 Bay Sink in main kitchen were observed in poor repair. Physical facilities to be in good repair and proper adjustment. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 12/27/2024
